## Experience

- Founding Full Stack Engineer · Entropy Systems (2023 — Present): architected and delivered 3 SaaS products for ISO standards auditing, now used by ~40 client companies, in a team of 3–5 engineers; full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js, Vite, Fastify, Node.js); LLM agent pipelines on AWS Bedrock processing ~2,000 audit documents per month and cutting manual review time by ~60%; 12 distributed services across AWS and GCP with 99.9% uptime; Docker and CI/CD pipelines that cut deployment time from ~1 hour to ~10 minutes, enabling daily releases.
- Frontend Engineer · Vintra, Inc. (2022 — 2023): led migration of a ~80k-line video analytics codebase from legacy JavaScript to TypeScript, reducing production runtime errors by ~30%; introduced Vite and esbuild, cutting build time from ~3 min to ~20 s.
- UI Development Lead · BITA GmbH (2022): led a team of 4 front-end engineers building 5 index and ETF analytics applications; introduced shift-left practices, raising test coverage from ~10% to ~70%; established shared component patterns.
- Full-Stack Engineer · BITA GmbH (2021 — 2022): financial applications for index construction and ETF analytics; asynchronous RabbitMQ workflows ingesting ~1M market-data records per day; REST APIs in Python and Node.js.
- Application Developer · Intelix Synergy (2020 — 2021): built 3 internal systems used daily by ~200 employees, in Python and Node.js on Linux/NGINX.
